'''The POTU''', for "the periphery of the Uscru", or alternatively, "the peril of the Uscru", was a [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|low-tier district]] on the edge of the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was considered a dangerous area home to numerous criminals, including turf gangs, serial killers, molesters and thieves. However, crimes tended to be directed against residents within the district, so the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] had little presence in the POTU. Even [[security camera]]s were scarce, as they were frequently stolen and disassembled for parts.

By [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], the POTU was slowly gentrifying. It could be accessed by the [[Deep Core Mag-Lev Line]]. Despite the danger, [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] or their aides could often be found in the district for thrill-seeking, conducting illegal deals, or indulging in [[Spice/Legends|proscribed substances]]. [[The Shimmersilk]] was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] in the POTU at this time.
